class.name: FmodEditorExportPlugin
class.brief_description: Adds the FMOD banks, audio files and plugin libraries to the game's exports.
class.description: Registered by the editor plugin. It packs the banks found in the banks folder and the audio files the project loads, unless the export preset's [code]fmod/auto_export_banks[/code] option is off, and adds the FMOD plugin libraries declared in the [FmodPluginsSettings] resource for the exported platform. On iOS it generates the code registering the static plugins.
